app.name: WebRadio
app.description: WebRadio was built to make listening to your favourite stations simple and stylish. Plugin support, adjustable themes and automatic updates keep you up to date.

home.title: Discover
home.empty: No stations found. Use the search in the sidebar.

integrations.subtitle: Connect external services
integrations.discordDescription: Shows the current song in your Discord status

updates.sectionHint: Updates are installed only after your confirmation.
updates.autoCheckHint: Checks at startup and periodically. Updates are never installed automatically.
updates.backupNote: The previous version is kept as a backup.

permissions.title: New permissions
permissions.intro: The new version requests additional permissions. Nothing is installed without your confirmation.

unsigned.title: Unsigned update
unsigned.warning: This update has no signature. The checksum and plugin ID are verified, but the origin is not cryptographically confirmed.

hints.incompatible: This version requires a different WebRadio version.

hints.channelMismatch: The manifest belongs to a different update channel.
hints.permissions: Nothing is installed until the new permissions are confirmed.

result.rolledBack: Update failed – the previous version was restored.

updates.title: Updates
updates.subtitle: Keep WebRadio up to date

status.availableSub: A new version is ready to download
status.availableBetaSub: Note: beta version – may contain bugs.
status.availableAlphaSub: Note: alpha version – experimental, may contain serious bugs.
status.availableRcSub: Note: release candidate – intended for final testing and approval.
status.downloadedSub: The update has been downloaded and is waiting to be installed
status.errorSub: Please check your internet connection and try again later.
status.idleSub: Select "Check now" to look for updates

updates.downloadedDescription: The update will be installed when WebRadio restarts.
updates.channelDescription: Choose which versions you are offered.

channelDescriptions.beta: Early versions with new features, but without full stability.
channelDescriptions.alpha: Experimental pre-release builds ahead of the beta channel.
channelDescriptions.rc: Release candidates for final testing and approval.

updates.betaHint: You now receive beta versions as well. These may be unstable.
updates.alphaHint: You now receive alpha versions as well. These are experimental and may contain unknown bugs.
updates.rcHint: You now receive release candidates. These are intended for final testing and may still contain bugs.
updates.channelSwitchNote: The selected channel is active for all update checks immediately. The installed version ({version}) still belongs to the {channel} channel and only changes once an update is installed.

betaModal.title: Enable beta versions
betaModal.intro: You are about to switch WebRadio to the beta channel.
betaModal.body: Beta versions are still in development and may not have been fully tested. They can contain bugs, crashes, broken features or other unexpected problems.
betaModal.warning: Only enable the beta channel if you are willing to report possible bugs and to work with less stable versions.
betaModal.question: Do you really want to enable the beta channel?

alphaModal.title: Enable alpha versions
alphaModal.intro: You are about to switch WebRadio to the alpha channel.
alphaModal.body: Alpha versions are experimental builds that have not even reached beta stability. They can contain serious bugs, data loss, crashes or other critical problems.
alphaModal.warning: Only developers should enable the alpha channel, and only if they are willing to report critical bugs and to work with very unstable versions.
alphaModal.question: Do you really want to enable the alpha channel?

rcModal.title: Enable release candidates
rcModal.intro: You are about to switch WebRadio to the release candidate channel.
rcModal.body: Release candidates are largely complete versions that receive final testing before the stable release. They may still contain bugs that will be fixed before the stable release.
rcModal.warning: Only enable the release candidate channel if you are willing to report remaining bugs.
rcModal.question: Do you really want to enable the release candidate channel?
